text_block_list.text:
When visiting gym, Biwa Hayahide, Winning 
Ticket, and Narita Taishin were there.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, Professor Hayahide~~!! Help me, 
help me~~~!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hm, what is it, Ticket?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I tried reading that training book you 
brought, but I don't get it at all!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It says to accelerate you need dynamic 
strength? And for that you gotta do 
dynamic training? Apparently—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
What does that even mean? Is it some kind 
of magic spell?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It is theory, not a spell. No choice, I 
shall explain.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...*ahem*. First, regarding dynamic 
strength, it refers to explosive power— 
power exerted instantaneously.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh, uh-huh!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ...Huuuh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
As for cultivating explosive power, one 
must train muscles known as fast-twitch 
fibers.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fast-twitch fibers are outer surface 
muscles, also called outer muscles. 
Training them yields greater explosive 
power.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And training fast-twitch fibers requires 
dynamic training. Prime example would be 
weight training.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...That concludes explanation. Explained 
it logically; did you understand?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh, I don't get it at aaall~~!! My 
head's spinning~~!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hm, demonstrating clearly will be 
faster...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —Ah, right. Let us do this.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Look, Ticket. You see that barbell over 
there?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Eh... that heavy-looking one?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes, precisely. That weighs approximately 
200 kg.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ehh?! 200 kg?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Without extraordinary muscle, one cannot 
lift it. —However.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
For me, who does weight training daily 
based on that book's theory, lifting it is 
simple.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: As stated earlier, theory is flawless.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, really?! Amazing, so amazing!! Hey 
hey, show me in action!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Watch closely. Witness how 
effective theory-based training truly is.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Wait, ...you sure about this?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmph...! From set position, lower hips 
gradually... ngh!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Behold...! Thighs and calves reach exact 
90-degree angle... ngh!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If I hold this... ngh, for 5 seconds...! 
Maintain posture... ngh!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Gnuuuu... ngh!! Theoretically, failure is 
impossible... ngh!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
*pant*...! *pant*...! *pant*...! How is 
that? Total success...! Just as theory 
dictates!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah!! Incredible, incredible!! 
Hayahide's theory is sooooo awesome!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'll try theory too! I'm gonna lift 100 kg 
barbells soon!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, glad you learned theory. Let us 
continue striving together, Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Theory...? Wasn't that just pure brute 
muscle in end...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: G-Gnuuuugh... ngh!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Kgh...! How pathetic...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh~ Even Hayahide's theory didn't 
work~...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No, theoretically failure is 
impossible...! Absolutely impossible...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Another day, I will lift that barbell no 
matter what...!! To prove theory...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
No... at that point, you're just talking 
about muscle, not theory...
